en-US.description: Ethereal Echoes is a meditative animated 3D screensaver.
en-US.longDescription:
Ethereal Echoes is a meditative animated screensaver that immerses your screen in a world of abstract light forms and flowing color streams.
Compatible with Windows 11, 10, 8, and 7.
Portable version - no installation required.
